d:
Terry Haines, founder of Pangaea Policy, says Nvidia and its board face potentially prolonged scrutiny over Jensen Huang. Haines, who helped run congressional investigations into Enron and WorldCom, expects board members to be called to testify “repeatedly” as lawmakers examine national security and corporate oversight. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg’s "Balance of Power."
More on Bloomberg Television and Markets
